name: WF-424 — Final Settlement Statement & Assignment Fee Reconciliation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const assignmentId=String(b.assignmentId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,assignmentId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Settlement Reconciliation Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const s=ctx.settlement??{}; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const statement=ctx.statement??{}; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const expectedAssignmentFee=num(s.assignmentFee??d.assignmentFee); const statementAssignmentFee=num(statement.assignmentFee); const buyerFunds=num(s.buyerFunds??statement.buyerFunds); const sellerPayoff=num(s.sellerPayoff??statement.sellerPayoff); const closingCosts=num(s.closingCosts??statement.closingCosts)??0; const otherCosts=num(s.otherCosts??statement.otherCosts)??0; const grossProceeds=num(s.grossProceeds??statement.grossProceeds); const calculatedNet=num(grossProceeds)!==null?grossProceeds-(closingCosts+otherCosts+(sellerPayoff??0)):null; const feeDelta=expectedAssignmentFee!==null&&statementAssignmentFee!==null?statementAssignmentFee-expectedAssignmentFee:null; const tolerance=0.01; const flags=[]; if(statement.status&&['void','cancelled','rejected'].includes(String(statement.status).toLowerCase()))flags.push('settlement_statement_invalid'); if(statement.final!==true)flags.push('final_settlement_statement_not_confirmed'); if(expectedAssignmentFee===null)flags.push('expected_assignment_fee_missing'); if(statementAssignmentFee===null)flags.push('statement_assignment_fee_missing'); if(feeDelta!==null&&Math.abs(feeDelta)>tolerance)flags.push('assignment_fee_mismatch'); if(buyerFunds!==null&&buyerFunds<0)flags.push('invalid_buyer_funds'); if(sellerPayoff!==null&&sellerPayoff<0)flags.push('invalid_seller_payoff'); const reconciled=flags.length===0; const decision=reconciled?'settlement_reconciled':flags.includes('assignment_fee_mismatch')?'hold_and_reconcile_fee':'hold_for_settlement_correction'; const idempotencyKey='wf424:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.assignmentId; return [{json:{...input,settlementReconciliation:{status:reconciled?'reconciled':'exception',decision,flags,amounts:{expectedAssignmentFee,statementAssignmentFee,assignmentFeeDelta:feeDelta,buyerFunds,sellerPayoff,closingCosts,otherCosts,grossProceeds,calculatedNet},tolerance,requiresHumanReview:flags.includes('assignment_fee_mismatch')||flags.includes('settlement_statement_invalid'),nextAction:reconciled?'release_final_settlement_for_closing_confirmation':'correct_statement_and_reconcile_again',confidenceScore:reconciled?98:Math.max(0,70-flags.length*10)},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, propertyId, dealId and assignmentId are required'} }}

meta.notes: Final settlement and assignment fee reconciliation is workflow scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM settlement schema, title/closing provider statement data, accounting rules, and production API contracts.
